examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: to beat, to hit, to strike

examples.text: Почему меня все бьют в этом доме?
examples.trans: Why does everyone beat me in this house?

examples.text: Тише, Ваня, осторожно! Зачем ты бьёшь дерево ногой?
examples.trans: Easy, Vanya, be careful! Why are you kicking the tree with your foot?
Everyone thinks you're in the hospital.
He was admitted to the hospital.

examples.text: Все думают, ты в больнице. Откуда деньги?
examples.trans: Everyone thinks you're in the hospital. Where did the money come from?

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Adds a reason or an obvious truth.

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.

meanings.note: до вечера = until the evening; вечером = in the evening

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
She's offended. She's always like that.

встать.gloss: to stand up, to get up

meanings.en: to stand up, to get up (out of bed)

examples.text: Кто первый встал, того и тапки.
examples.trans: First come, first served (whoever got up first gets the slippers).

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
He is running in the election.

examples.text: У меня много дел. Выборы мэра…
examples.trans: I've got a lot to do. The mayoral election...

выпить.gloss: to drink (up); to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink of

examples.trans: May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Милый, можно я выпью капельку пива?
examples.trans: Darling, may I drink a tiny drop of beer?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

meanings.note: substantivized adjective, declines like an adjective

examples.trans: It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.text: Всё отлично, отдыхай! Сегодня выходные, всё круто!
examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

meanings.en: голову оторвать = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Какая тебе опергруппа? Мне твоя мать голову оторвёт.
examples.trans: What field team? Your mother will tear my head off.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.trans: I put on a bunny costume!
The children saw a little bunny.

examples.text: Что, я зря пришла? Я надела костюм зайки!
examples.trans: What, did I come for nothing? I put on a bunny costume!

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.
Even I feel a bit ashamed right now.
It became somehow quiet in the room.
For long? You need to convince me somehow!

meanings.note: выдвигать кандидатуру = put forward one's candidacy

examples.trans: I am putting forward my candidacy.

examples.text: Он выдвигает свою кандидатуру на пост мэра города!
examples.trans: He is putting forward his candidacy for the post of mayor of the city!

examples.text: Да, да! Я выдвигаю свою кандидатуру.
examples.trans: Yes, yes! I am putting forward my candidacy.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.en: что ли = or what, I suppose

examples.trans: I don't know whether he is at home.
Was it Osipenko who hired you?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

надолго.gloss: for a long time, for long

meanings.en: for a long time, for long
meanings.note: question: надолго? = for how long / for long?

examples.trans: For long? You need to convince me somehow!
He left for Moscow for a long time.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
неделю = for a week; через неделю = in a week

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
ночью = at night; спокойной ночи = good night

examples.text: Ну что, Аркаша? Наступила ночь, просыпается мафия.
examples.trans: So, Arkasha? Night has fallen, the mafia wakes up.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.en: match (in a relationship: я не пара вам = I'm no match for you)

examples.text: Я понимаю, я не пара вам.
examples.trans: I understand I'm no match for you.
They are a very handsome couple.

examples.text: Я понимаю, я не пара вам. Вы красавец, а я старая.
examples.trans: I understand I'm no match for you. You're a handsome man, and I'm old.

meanings.note: substantivized neuter adjective, declines like an adjective

examples.text: Мы купили свежие пирожные к чаю.
examples.trans: We bought fresh pastries for tea.

examples.text: Я пирожные принёс! Может, мы пока чаю попьём?
examples.trans: I brought pastries! Maybe we could have some tea in the meantime?

meanings.note: used on its own: он пьёт = he drinks

examples.text: Всё, теперь ты герой? И можно только пить?
examples.trans: So now you're a hero? And all you have to do is drink?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.
Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.en: to get to, to end up
meanings.note: как попасть в центр? = how do I get to the centre?

examples.trans: A firework hit the power station.
How do I get to the station?

examples.text: Скажи: салют попал в станцию. Три района без света.
examples.trans: Say a firework hit the power station. Three districts without electricity.

examples.text: Так, не портите мне прекрасное настроение.
examples.trans: Right, don't ruin my wonderful mood.

examples.text: Поверьте, вам это не надо. Вы так карму портите.
examples.trans: Believe us, you do not need this. You ruin your karma that way.

meanings.note: у нас к вам просьба = we have a request for you

examples.trans: We have a request for you.

examples.text: У меня к тебе маленькая просьба.
examples.trans: I have a small favour to ask of you.

examples.text: Добрый вечер! У нас к вам просьба.
examples.trans: Good evening! We have a request for you.

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

examples.text: Тогда ребята с тобой поработают. До свидания, Аркадий Борисович.
examples.trans: Then the boys will have a little word with you. Goodbye, Arkady Borisovich.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

снять.gloss: to film, to photograph; to take off; to rent

meanings.en: to film, to take a photo/video of

examples.text: Я сняла пьяного соседа на телефон.
examples.trans: I filmed a drunk neighbour on my phone.
He took off his coat by the door.

examples.text: Я сняла пьяного соседа на телефон. И сразу все мне помогают!
examples.trans: I filmed a drunk neighbour on my phone. And right away everyone helps me!
You can see it at once.
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

examples.text: Если проблема только в этом, то да.
examples.trans: If that's the only problem, then yes.

examples.text: А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: Otherwise we were already starting to worry.

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: 1st person singular future is not used by itself

examples.text: Ты его убедила? Ты уверена в этом?
examples.trans: You convinced him? Are you sure about this?

ходить.gloss: to walk, to go (on foot, regularly)

meanings.en: to walk, to go on foot
meanings.note: back and forth or habitually; one trip in one direction: идти

examples.text: Мальчик ходит на костылях. А она ещё и активистка.
examples.trans: The boy walks on crutches. And she's an activist, too.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.note: + accusative: через неделю = in a week

examples.text: Нормально? Она через неделю снова потечёт!
examples.trans: Fine? It'll be leaking again in a week!

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
